You’ve just installed DS audio, and have a Synology NAS: take a look at what you can do with them!
Stream your music anywhere you go. Whether comfortably at home or out for your daily workout, never leave your music behind.
DS audio doesn’t just stream music: it also downloads your favorite songs so you always have them on hand, whether network is unavailable, or your data plan limited.
Often throwing parties? Let your friends create playlists and choose the songs they love. DS audio will even stream directly to your stereo players, becoming a real remote control.
Even when at a friend’s house, DS audio can share your music collection to AirPlay, Bluetooth speakers or Chromecast.
